key_insight: GS-Agent turns text prompts into physically plausible 4D worlds by using multiple specialized agents to iteratively build, simulate, and refine scenes with a physics engine in the loop.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a practical blueprint for automating high-fidelity, controllable scene synthesis for virtual production, robotics simulation, and creative design workflows.
method: Decomposes generation into entity management and rendering configuration.
Uses multiple agents for asset curation, material tuning, placement, motion, camera, and lighting.
Iterates with physics-engine feedback and multimodal cues to improve physical realism.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experimental results showing diverse 4D worlds with liquids, deformables, and rigid bodies, plus cinematic camera and lighting control.
watch_item: Performance likely depends on the quality of available 3D assets, physics models, and agent coordination, which may limit robustness in complex or novel scenes.
paper_title: GS-Agent: Creating 4D Physical Worlds With Generative Simulation
